description: No spec subject (candidates: specled.append_only when picked up). Severity: Medium. From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. authorizing_decision/2 matches an ADR by change_type/affects without checking its status field, so a superseded or rejected ADR in the same PR still suppresses weakening findings. Keep-reason: interacts with the F1 uniform-emission design decision (same choke point); landing it separately risks two conflicting authorization contracts. Concrete failure: a PR carrying a rejected ADR whose affects lists x.req_a gets its weakening of x.req_a silently authorized.
title: F13: authorizing_decision/2 ignores ADR status — superseded/rejected ADRs still authorize
